nv_usgs_ds249.provenance_note: Source and scale are stamped on every polygon/line from the reviewed DS 249 publication and checksum-pinned ZIP. Per-record geometry types are inventoried because the ESRI layer schema understates multipart features. Reviewed invalid geology is repaired in native EPSG:26711 before reprojection, with exact repair and area-delta evidence. Two zero-area source polygons have null geometry and are inventoried explicitly rather than silently dropped. Fifteen valid sub-2-meter fault traces below the z12 MVT encoding resolution are likewise exact-inventoried; they are not counted as rendered features or fabricated into longer faults.
